notes.title: Demo update — Chinese translation
notes.content: [p]The translation for Simplified Chinese has arrived to the demo! Thanks a lot to Huang "Shuyuan" Teng for working on the translation! Alongside with it, some visual changes.[/p][p][/p][p]The work on the game is still ongoing, but has been somewhat offset due to personal circumstances. I am hoping to bring this game to a finished state as soon as possible![/p]

tags.feature: - The translation for Simplified Chinese has arrived to the demo!

notes.title: Demo update
notes.content: Many players have asked for readability improvements in the GUI. This update brings this in the form of a new, more readable font, as well as environment updates and bugfixes.

notes.title: New update: Feedback form and some bugfixes
notes.content: Since it's a little difficult to gather feedback on a demo on steam, I've made a [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScSp7aXlowHnloTRw5ZcLqr5_Q0j57bvCx1Q4fYH4uQC9MrvA/viewform]feedback survey[/url]. It also now appears in the demo's thank you message. I would be very grateful if you took the time to fill it!
